reader_summary.headline: We complete our two-part Netflix special with the company’s bold transition to streaming.
reader_summary.overview: We complete our two-part Netflix special with the company’s bold transition to streaming, including of course the most (in)famous spin-out in business history. Rising from the ashes of Qwikster, we chronicle Netflix’s rebirth as a media company and long journey back to the top of the FAANG mountaintop! Sponsors: Legora: Vanta: ServiceNow: Statsig: More Acquired!
